mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE department_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM sys_dept WHERE id = #{deptId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM sys_dept child INNER JOIN department_tree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.deleted = 0 AND child.status = 0 ) SELECT id FROM department_tree
